title: Bearded Buffalo Resort

services.name: Seasonal RV Sites
services.desc: Located minutes from Custer State Park, Bearded Buffalo Resort offers spacious, level, full-hookup RV sites with 30/50 amp electric, water, and sewer. Ideal for monthly or seasonal stays, the pet-friendly resort features reliable Wi-Fi, a general store, a seasonal coffee cabin, a turf play area, and upcoming additions like a pickleball court and a fire pit gathering space. Long-term guests enjoy the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation with easy access to the park's scenic trails, Mount Rushmore, and Stockade Lake. services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Located near downtown Custer, SD, Bearded Buffalo Resort offers cozy two- and three-bedroom cabins perfect for families, groups, or long-term stays. Each pet-friendly cabin features queen beds, vaulted ceilings, a loft, a full kitchen, a private bathroom, and an in-unit washer/dryer available exclusively to cabin guests and not available to RV guests. Modern essentials like air conditioning, Wi-Fi, linens, and parking for two vehicles are included. Guests enjoy excellent on-site amenities, including a general store, a seasonal coffee box, a large turf play area, and an upcoming pickleball court and fire pit.
